items.title: Windows 11 File Explorer Now Deletes Large Files Significantly Faster
items.summary: Update to Windows 11 July 2026 update (KB5101650) via Windows Update to get the faster File Explorer deletion.

items.title: Turn On Windows Storage Sense to Automatically Free 5-50 GB Monthly
items.summary: Open Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense > Turn on. Set cleanup schedule to 'During low free disk space' or 'Monthly'. Configure cleanup schedules for temp files, Recycle Bin (30 days), and Downloads folder (60 days).

items.title: FTC Warns: Fake CAPTCHA Scams Hijack Your Computer
items.summary: Scammers use fake CAPTCHAs that tell you to press Windows+R, paste, and Enter — this runs malicious code. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Close the tab immediately if a verification asks you to open Run or paste anything.

items.title: Microsoft Fixes 622 Security Flaws — Biggest Patch Tuesday Ever
items.summary: July 2026 Patch Tuesday addresses 622 vulnerabilities including 6 critical remote code execution flaws and starts mandatory Kerberos RC4 enforcement. Open Settings → Windows Update → Check for updates, install, and restart. Network admins: test Kerberos AES compatibility.

items.title: Storage Sense — Windows' Free Cleanup Tool Runs Automatically
items.summary: Press Start and type "Storage Sense", turn it On. Click Configure Storage Sense and choose how often to run (daily/weekly/monthly). Set Delete files in Recycle Bin after to 30 days. Set Delete files in Downloads folder after to 60 days (or Never if you keep installers). Automatically frees 10-50 GB of temp files and junk — no extra software needed. Works on Windows 10 and 11.

items.title: FTC scam alert — fake agents call demanding payment, hang up and call 1-877-FTC-HELP
items.summary: Your caller ID says FTC. The voice sounds official, uses a real employee name, claims identity theft or recovered money. They need verification or a fee. The FTC does NOT cold-call, never demands gift cards/crypto/wire/gold, and has no badge agents. Hang up. Share nothing. If concerned, call FTC yourself at 1-877-FTC-HELP or visit ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

items.title: Firefox 153 ships Containers by default — separate Work, Personal, Banking, Shopping in one window free
items.summary: Open Firefox 153+, click the menu -> New Container Tab -> pick Work, Personal, Banking, or Shopping. Each Firefox Container has its own cookies, logins, and tracking - Google in your Work Container cannot see your Personal YouTube history. No extension needed; it is built in.

items.title: Run Llama 3.3 8B locally on 8GB RAM — Ollama + Open WebUI is free, offline, no account needed
items.summary: Install Ollama from ollama.com (Windows/macOS/Linux), then run 'ollama run llama3.3:8b' - that is a local model. For a chat UI, run 'docker run -d -p 3000:8080 -v open-webui:/app/backend/data ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main' and open localhost:3000. Your prompts never leave your machine.
